_comment: Copy this file to tokens.json (which is gitignored) and fill in real values. See SETUP.md for where to find each one.
_env_vars_comment: Any of these can be overridden by env vars instead of committing to tokens.json: SLACK_CLIENT_ID, SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET, SLACK_APP_TOKEN, SLACK_AUDIT_CHANNEL_ID. Useful for CI / secret-manager flows. Env vars win when both are set.

users._example: Filled in automatically by auth_user.py — one entry per persona email

_optional_audit_logging_comment: Only fill in app_token + audit_channel_id if you want every send/delete logged to a Slack channel. See SETUP.md Step 8.
